name: Fontys University of Applied Sciences
summary: Hands-on university of applied sciences in Eindhoven, Tilburg and Venlo: small classes, company projects and internships.

ib.text: The IB Diploma is named as giving access. Many programmes also want satisfactory maths grades, engineering also physics or chemistry, with no IB grade set. An IB Diploma usually exempts you from an English test.

dates.label: Apply by 1 May for a September 2027 start; arts programmes differ
Fontys housing application due, September 2027 start

programmes.name: Applied Mathematics
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths; Fontys sets no IB grade.
programmes.about: Mathematical modelling, programming and data science applied to real problems from companies, with AI used as a tool; two internships, and a data science specialisation from year 3.
programmes.overview: The first years build calculus, linear algebra, simulation and statistics, and you learn to program in MATLAB, Python and AIMMS to turn real-world problems into mathematical models. Much of the work is project-based, often for outside companies, and AI is used as a tool in solving them. Two internships are part of the degree, with companies in the Brainport Eindhoven region, and you study on the Eindhoven University of Technology campus. In year three you can specialise in data science. Graduates work as mathematicians in organisations of many kinds or move on to a master's.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Applied Physics
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths and physics; Fontys sets no IB grade.
programmes.about: Physics theory, lab experiments and projects on problems such as energy, hospital equipment and sound, in a small programme on the TU/e campus in Eindhoven.
programmes.overview: The early years cover mathematics, optics, mechanics, thermodynamics, atomic and nuclear physics, electromagnetism, quantum mechanics, measurement technology and programming. Teaching mixes lectures with laboratory experiments in well-equipped facilities and projects such as building a working multimeter, and later assignments come from companies and research groups. You study on the Eindhoven University of Technology campus and can choose between a structured route and more freedom. Graduates work as physics researchers, product developers or process-optimisation consultants at employers such as TNO, ASML, Canon, DAF and Bosch or in hospital laboratories, and a master's is also possible.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Applied Science - Chemistry and Chemical Engineering
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths and chemistry; Fontys sets no IB grade.
programmes.about: Chemistry, chemical engineering and biology taught together as one toolkit for work on medicines, sustainable materials, clean water or diagnostics, in a small programme on the TU/e campus.
programmes.overview: Biology, chemistry and technology are taught side by side, and during the first two years you pick three theme modules to steer towards areas such as biomedical applications, pharmaceutical development, sustainable materials or water treatment. Lab work with professional equipment happens every week, in small classes, and the final year centres on a ten-month research project. Biomedical Engineering is available as a specialisation from the end of year one, and year three leaves room for an internship, a minor or pre-master's courses. The Brainport Eindhoven setting links you to companies such as Philips Healthcare and BASF and to local hospitals. Graduates go into laboratory research, product development or diagnostics, or on to a master's.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Automotive Engineering
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths and physics; Fontys sets no IB grade.
programmes.about: Mechanics, electronics and software applied to vehicles: you design, build and test them, with half a day a week in the workshop in year 1 before you choose a direction.
programmes.overview: You study mathematics, physics, mechanics, electronics, programming, vehicle design and simulation, and measurement and testing. Theory is tied to real vehicles: you move from small model cars in year one to building a complete low-energy vehicle by the end of year two, with lab measurements feeding back into class. Year three brings a 20-week internship and a minor, such as Motorsport Engineering, and year four takes real questions from industry in Helmond. Most graduates enter the automotive sector, with employers such as DAF and VDL, while others go into high-tech industries like semiconductors, or into a master's in System Design or a pre-master at TU/e.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Circus and Performance Art
programmes.closesNote: Two audition videos due by 5 April 2027
programmes.ib: Audition: Studielink by 1 April 2027, two videos by 5 April, then a live audition in Tilburg on 18–20 May 2027.
programmes.about: Professional circus training with a flexible curriculum built around your own artistic goals, in a dedicated training hall in Tilburg with internationally qualified teachers.
programmes.overview: Training centres on studio work in the circus discipline you choose, supplemented by trampoline, acrobatics, rigging basics and stage presence. Guest artists from abroad come in for intensive teaching periods, and you work on projects with students of dance, theatre, music and visual arts, since the school shares its Tilburg campus with many other arts programmes. In the third year a minor lets you train away from the school for a while, and performances and internships give professional experience. Graduates work as independent or company performers, form their own companies, or take technical and creative roles such as rigger, light or sound technician, stage designer or choreographer.
programmes.selectionNote: Two videos by 5 April 2027 (online preselection); if selected, a live audition in Tilburg on 18–20 May 2027, and you must be there all three days.

programmes.name: Communication - International Communication Management
programmes.about: How organisations plan and manage communication across cultures and borders: communication strategy, intercultural understanding and working with people in diverse contexts.
programmes.overview: You begin with the basics of communication theory and its use, branding and media strategy, intercultural communication, research methods, presentation skills and creative writing, and specialise in later years. Classes are interactive, and you work in teams on real projects and campaigns for clients while building collaboration, leadership and feedback skills. An internship and a semester abroad at one of Fontys' partner universities are part of the experience, in a multicultural classroom on the Eindhoven campus. Graduates become communication advisors, content managers, PR specialists, brand managers or marketing consultants, and many continue to a master's.
programmes.ib: No subjects required beyond the IB Diploma.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Dance - Dance Arts in Context
programmes.ib: Audition for one profile: Studielink by 1 March, material by 4 March, live audition in Tilburg 19–22 April 2027, plus a medical test.
programmes.about: Contemporary, contemporary urban or choreography: you develop your own dance style and choreographic skills and explore current trends, in an international setting in Tilburg.
programmes.overview: Daily studio classes build technique across contemporary, urban and other styles, alongside theory on dance history and communication and on social topics such as inclusivity, gender, body positivity and racism. You make and perform work in collaborative projects with national and international partners and with students from other art programmes on the Zwijsenplein campus, which holds many arts courses. You follow one of three profiles: Contemporary, Contemporary Urban or Choreography. Graduates work in the performing arts and wider society, drawing on an international dance network; alumni have danced with companies such as the Martha Graham Company, taught, or combined dance with psychology and therapy.
programmes.selectionNote: Online preselection (material by 4 Mar 2027) for one profile; if selected, a live audition in Tilburg on 19–22 Apr 2027 and a medical test. No online option.

programmes.name: Electrical and Electronic Engineering
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths; Fontys sets no IB grade.
programmes.about: Designing the electronics inside devices, from patient monitors to electric cars and energy systems, with a focus on sustainable solutions.
programmes.overview: Year one covers electronics fundamentals, programming and mathematics, with you building working devices such as volume controllers, metal detectors or vending machines; year two adds signal processing and power electronics. Teaching is mostly project-based, with team prototypes, lab work and a portfolio rather than many exams. A work placement in year three and a graduation internship in year four sit around a minor, and in year four you specialise in Electronic Systems, Embedded Systems or Innovation Engineering. Graduates become designers, advisors, test engineers or embedded software engineers in fields like electric vehicles and medical devices, or go on to a master's such as Digital Technology Engineering.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Finance & Control
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths and economics (Fontys also names business economics); no IB grade is set.
programmes.about: Finance, accounting, risk management and strategic decision-making for businesses, with company projects and classes of at most 30 in Venlo. Formerly International Finance & Control.
programmes.overview: The first year spans finance and accounting, marketing, business management, logistics, risk management, data analytics and strategic management, after which you choose your own specialisation. Learning is project-based, with assignments for real companies from the first year onward, a compulsory internship, and classes of no more than 30 students in Venlo. Year three offers internship and minor options abroad, supported by a network of partner universities and regional companies. Graduates work as controllers, financial managers, financial analysts, data analysts or business advisors, often at the company where they interned.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: ICT: Information & Communication Technology
programmes.about: A broad ICT bachelor's: a common start, then one of 13 specialisations such as AI, cyber security or software development, built on real-life projects.
programmes.overview: The common first stage covers programming at several levels (hard coding, low code and no code), digital infrastructure and system design, data analysis and management, and current developments such as AI, data protection and the Internet of Things. You then choose from 13 specialisations, including Cyber Security, Artificial Intelligence, Game Design & Development, Robotics and User Interaction Design. Work is project-based for around 120 partner companies in the Brainport and Midpoint Brabant regions, with lab work on physical systems, a compulsory internship, a portfolio and optional study abroad. Graduates become security advisors, AI consultants, data analysts, cloud engineers, game developers or UX designers.
programmes.ib: No subjects required beyond the IB Diploma.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Industrial Design Engineering
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths; Fontys sets no IB grade.
programmes.about: Product design covering form, use, function, production and market value, with sustainability and social impact built in, through design assignments with companies in Venlo.
programmes.overview: Design, technology and business come together, covering product design and visualisation, technical problem-solving, manufacturing and production, usability and user-centred design, and sustainability and social impact. From year one you work on live projects for real clients, in team-based studio assignments with companies, and document your results in a portfolio, with coaching from lecturers and a study coach. Year three offers an internship or minor abroad through the network of partners around the Venlo campus. Graduates work as product designers, design engineers, freelance design consultants or structural packaging designers, with employers such as Philips, Canon and Bosch, and can continue to a master in design or engineering.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Industrial Engineering and Management
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths; Fontys sets no IB grade.

separateFrom.name: Industrial Design Engineering
separateFrom.reason: A different subject (engineering management, not product design), taught in Eindhoven, not Venlo.

programmes.about: Improving and managing the processes of technical organisations, with projects for Brainport companies such as ASML and Philips and a personal coach throughout.
programmes.overview: You start with business economics, corporate social responsibility, production technology, process analysis and improvement, and data analysis. Learning happens through group assignments and projects at technical companies in the region, followed by a compulsory internship and a graduation project with industry partners. You choose one of five specialisations: Automotive and Mobility Management, Commercial & Organisational Excellence, Operational Excellence, Smart Industry, or Sustainability Excellence & Regenerative Design. The Brainport Eindhoven campus is shared with the Eindhoven University of Technology and has ties to companies such as ASML, Philips, VDL and DAF. Graduates work as supply chain coordinators, project managers or quality engineers.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Information Technology
programmes.about: Software and AI development in teams for real clients: you analyse complex problems and build digital solutions, with attention to people and society, in Venlo.
programmes.overview: The first part builds a broad base in software development: programming in Java, Python, C# and JavaScript, SQL and database concepts, tools such as Git and Docker, and Agile and Scrum ways of working. Learning is project-based, applying theory to real challenges in international teams, and shaped further by internships and a graduation assignment. After about a year and a half you choose a specialisation: Business Informatics, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security, Data Science or Embedded Software. Graduates work as software or database developers, data scientists, AI developers or security professionals, or continue their studies.
programmes.ib: No subjects required beyond the IB Diploma.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: International Business
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in one of maths, economics or business economics; no IB grade is set.
programmes.about: A BBA covering international business, culture, marketing, finance, supply chain and HR, with classmates from across the world, in Eindhoven or Venlo.
programmes.overview: You study four main business areas, namely marketing and sales, finance and accounting, supply chain and operations, and human resources, together with economics and general business knowledge. Lectures give the foundations and group projects apply them to realistic business situations. An international internship in another country is part of the degree, and exchange at partner universities is possible. You can study in Venlo, a smaller international community, or in Eindhoven, a technology and design hub. Graduates work as business developers, international marketers, product managers or HR managers.

needs.note: Any one of these; Fontys also names business economics.

programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Logistics Engineering
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths; Fontys sets no IB grade.
programmes.about: Logistics processes, data analysis and teamwork, with internships and company projects from the start in Venlo; prepares you for engineer or analyst roles.
programmes.overview: The first year covers logistics and business operations, marketing and finance, warehousing and distribution, supply chain management, data analytics, IT in logistics, and simulation and automation. Learning is hands-on, with company projects from the start, company visits, lectures from industry experts and two internships; after year one you choose your own field of study. The programme is based in Venlo, a logistics hub in Europe, and year three allows an internship or minor abroad. The first year is shared with Logistics Management, International Business, Finance & Control and Marketing Management. Graduates become logistics engineers or advisors, operations or supply chain managers, or data analysts.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Logistics Management
programmes.about: Preparation for management roles in logistics, with a focus on sustainability and data, internships and projects, and a personal mentor, in Venlo.
programmes.overview: The first year covers marketing and business basics, finance, logistics processes, supply chain management, leadership and change management, and sustainability and ethics. You carry out company projects every semester, complete two internships, hear guest lectures from professionals and visit logistics sites, in small classes with coaching in teamwork and leadership. The first year is shared with Logistics Engineering, International Business, Finance & Control and Marketing Management, so you can switch without delay. Venlo is one of the major logistics hotspots in Europe. Graduates work as supply chain, logistics, operations or warehouse managers, sustainability advisors or distribution planners.
programmes.ib: No subjects required beyond the IB Diploma.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Marketing Management

separateFrom.name: Marketing Management - Digital Business Concepts
separateFrom.reason: Venlo, without the Digital Business Concepts specialisation; the Tilburg version records an intake conversation on your economics background.

programmes.about: Market analysis, consumer behaviour, online channels, sales and product development, with two six-month internships worldwide and classes of at most 30 in Venlo.
programmes.overview: You begin with marketing strategy and brand management, business and finance basics, consumer behaviour and business psychology, and digital channels such as social media, plus logistics at the Venlo campus. Projects for real companies run through the whole degree, in cohorts of at most 30, along with two six-month internships at organisations worldwide and an optional exchange semester in year three. After year one you shape your own focus, for example digital marketing, branding, market research or international marketing. Graduates become content creators, digital marketing managers, brand managers or communication consultants.
programmes.ib: No subjects required beyond the IB Diploma.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Marketing Management - Digital Business Concepts
programmes.ib: Economics, business or management courses required; if yours fall short, an intake conversation looks at catching up before you enrol.

separateFrom.name: Marketing Management
separateFrom.reason: A different specialisation (Digital Business Concepts) in Tilburg, not Venlo, and only this one records an intake conversation that checks your economics background.

programmes.about: A mix of digital, marketing and business: you learn to design, develop and market digital products and business models with data, on assignments from companies, in Tilburg.
programmes.overview: The programme starts with marketing fundamentals, business and finance basics, consumer behaviour through business psychology, brand strategy, managing social media channels, sales processes, and e-commerce and business model development. You work on marketing projects for real companies throughout, in classes of at most 30, complete two six-month internships, and can take an exchange semester in year three before a graduation assignment. After year one you pick a focus such as digital marketing, branding, market research or international marketing, in Tilburg or Venlo. Graduates become social media managers, communication consultants, brand managers, content creators or online marketers.

needs.note: Fontys asks for courses in economics, business and/or management.

programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; an intake talk follows if your economics is short.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths and physics; Fontys sets no IB grade.
programmes.about: Applying physics to design and build mechanical systems, structures and machines, with in-depth study of materials, lab work and industry projects.
programmes.overview: The early years build mechanics, thermodynamics, materials science, design and drafting, and physics applied to mechanical systems. Learning is hands-on and project-based, with extensive practical work in labs and workplaces, research assignments for companies, team projects such as a hovercraft, roller coaster or drone, and coaching for personal development. In later years you follow an Engineering, Energy or Innovation focus. The programme draws on the Brainport Eindhoven high-tech region, on a campus shared with TU/e, and on Greenport Venlo. Graduates work as engineers, sustainability project leaders, technical buyers or in medical R&D, and can continue at Fontys or TU/e.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Mechatronics
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths and physics; Fontys sets no IB grade.
programmes.about: Designing control systems for robot-controlled products and machines, mixing mechanical, electrical and software engineering in projects, in Eindhoven or Venlo.
programmes.overview: Mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, software development and mathematics are combined, and you work with students from other engineering fields on real challenges from year one. Teaching relies on hands-on projects, modern labs, guided projects with companies and an internship. The two campuses differ: Eindhoven centres on high-tech robotics and systems in the Brainport ecosystem, while Venlo leans towards sustainability and smart manufacturing in the Greenport region. Graduates work as system architects, service engineers, industrial automation specialists, designers, control technicians, technical consultants or project managers, in sectors such as healthcare, robotics, software, R&D and maintenance, or continue to a master.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Medical Imaging and Radiation Therapy
programmes.ib: Satisfactory grades in maths (Fontys checks your level); physics recommended; no IB grade is set.
programmes.about: Training to work with medical imaging and radiation therapy equipment: anatomy, imaging studies, radiation safety and patient care, in small classes in Eindhoven.
programmes.overview: You study anatomy and pathology, imaging technologies such as MRI, CT, SPECT and X-ray, radiation science including protection, patient communication and care, and how to operate equipment and process scans. Year one is about orientation and teamwork, and year two moves to advanced imaging and radiation planning. Practical labs and projects sit alongside roughly 20 classroom hours a week, a 20-week internship in year three with real patients, a minor, and a graduation project with a further internship in year four. Graduates work as diagnostic radiographers, radiation therapists, imaging specialists or clinical researchers, mainly in hospitals, clinics and research settings.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

programmes.name: Music - Conservatory of Music Tilburg
programmes.closesNote: A second upload round closes 1 May
programmes.ib: Audition and theory test: upload by 1 March 2027 (auditions 15–19 March) or 1 May 2027 (24–28 May); online interview if you live outside NL or Belgium.
programmes.about: Classical or jazz music in a broad musical context, with teachers active on the music scene and ensemble projects that connect you with professionals, in Tilburg.
programmes.overview: Your main subject, taught in individual and group lessons with technique work, sits at the centre, next to ensemble playing, music theory linked to current topics, and subjects that broaden your range. There are several project weeks a year, co-creation with dance, circus and visual arts students, and performances from concert halls to public spaces. You follow either the Classical route, with a contemporary approach and room to switch creative roles, or Jazz & Creative Music, built on improvisation, your own sound and specialised ensembles; Tilburg jazz venue PARADOX offers students concerts and jam sessions. Graduates perform on stages at home and abroad, work across art forms, teach, or move into arts management and policy, or a master.
programmes.selectionNote: Upload audition material by 1 Mar or 1 May 2027; if selected, an online interview (outside NL/Belgium) or live audition, plus an online theory test.

programmes.name: Physiotherapy
programmes.about: All aspects of physiotherapy, from treating injuries to preventing them, with anatomy, neurology and physiology, hands-on practice and real patients, in small classes.
programmes.overview: You learn anatomy and physiology, neurology, orthopaedics and pathology, basic techniques such as movement therapy and massage, and social skills. A typical week combines 16 class hours, four project hours and 16 hours of self-study, with patient contact from year one, where you assess patients and draw up treatment plans under supervision. Internships run through the programme and finish with a final placement alongside a research project. In years three and four you choose a focus programme in Healthcare, Self-Management or Interprofessional Collaboration, plus a minor. Graduates work as physiotherapists in hospitals, nursing homes, rehabilitation centres, schools, private practices, companies, fitness centres and sports associations.
programmes.ib: No required subjects; Fontys recommends biology, English and maths.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. Apply in Studielink by 1 May 2027; a study choice check talk is optional.

notes: If you miss 1 May, most programmes still take EEA applicants until the final deadline (1 or 15 August), but with fewer housing options.
Eleven of these bachelor's, including Automotive, Mechanical Engineering, ICT and Finance & Control, can also start in February; apply before 15 November for that.
Circus, Dance and Music in Tilburg select by audition, with deadlines months before 1 June.
